_README: Character ceilings for always-loaded memory files. P2 of the shared-session-memory
plan: notes/JUNIPER_2026-08-18_JUNIPER-ML_SHARED-SESSION-MEMORY-PLAN.md
Enforced by util/memory_budget_check.py via the standalone advisory 'Memory Budget'
job in ci.yml. CHARACTERS, not bytes -- the shipped Claude Code check compares
content.length (mechanism-facts section 1).
The ceiling starts at the size on the day the gate landed, so it is satisfiable
immediately and governs only GROWTH. That is deliberate: the rate axis ships first
and needs no destination, while the level axis waits for P3. Ratchet it down after
each cut with:  python util/memory_budget_check.py --ratchet
BUT --ratchet TIGHTENS TO THE EXACT CURRENT SIZE, leaving ZERO headroom, so the
very next author to add one character fails. After a real cut, prefer a hand-edit
to a value with DELIBERATE SLACK -- enough working room for the observed burn rate
(measured 2026-08-23: +937 chars over four days / five PRs, median +58, but a single
documentation PR took +605). --ratchet has no slack option; that is why the ceiling
is edited by hand here. Lowering never trips the anti-loosening guard.
RAISING a ceiling FAILS the gate (rule 4, added 2026-08-23). If a raise is genuinely
intended, declare it with an  Allow-Ceiling-Raise: <path>  commit trailer -- which is
deliberately NOT the same trailer as Allow-Budget-Overrun, because an overrun borrows
against a ceiling that still stands while a raise moves it and erases the debt.
docs/REFERENCE.md is deliberately NOT governed. It is the migration DESTINATION;
capping it would penalise exactly the relocation this plan wants, and it is not an
always-loaded memory file -- it is read on demand, which is the entire point.

AGENTS.md._note: Ratcheted 2026-08-23 from 45084 after the CI/CD Workflows relocation (ml#1271) took the file to 36792. Deliberately 38000, NOT 36792: --ratchet tightens to the exact current size, which leaves ZERO headroom and fails the very next author. The 1208-char slack is about five days of working room at the measured burn (+937 over four days / five PRs, median +58 but one docs PR took +605). Target after P3 is still 32443.
